Actual transparent alpha background. Each full icon remains inside its own cell; stable rigid-container framing is essential for switching between this atlas and the original.

25% remaining. Fish snacks: a single bitten fish fragment approximately three-quarter of one starting fish, about one quarter of the original total, no full fish added. Kibble: bowl mostly empty with a small quarter-portion cluster of kibble at the bottom, inner bowl exposed. Tubes: both tubes almost empty, flattened and rolled used ends, tiny cream remnant at the tip; keep the same plain pink-orange identity.
